motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present an ordinance amending Section 22.484g(A)7 of Division 22, Chapter 20, Article 5 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC), to be amended as follows: The Transportation Commission shall have the power, duty and responsibility of advising the coordination, direction, and management of all matters with respect to the acquisition, and thereafter the management, of all public off-street parking places by the City except for those parking facilities which are under jurisdiction or control of departments controlling their own funds and any facilities, and the instruction the City Council and Mayor has authorized for temporary or permanent use as a housing or homeless program. Notwithstanding the authority provided to the Department of General Services in Chapter 21 of Division 22 of this Code, the Los Angeles Housing Department shall have charge, superintendence and control of all City-owned real property, the use of which currently is or is approved by the City Council and Mayor to be for affordable housing development purposes, projects or activities. Responsibility for the maintenance and operations of the site shall remain with the Department of Transportation until the Ground Lease. or similar agreement, is executed and the Los Angeles Housing Department, or its designee, has provided the Department of Transportation with 30 days notice of intent to proceed with the project or program. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO), with support from the Department of Transportation, to update the Asset Evaluation Framework (CF:12-1549-S3) to reflect the removal of the Board DRIGINAL of Transportation Commissioners (BOTC) from relevant approval processes. EUNISSES HERNANDEŽ MOZ Councilmember, 1st District SEP 22 2026
